name: scoped_memory
description: Session and Hub memory: op=view|create|update|delete. update/delete require the actual rev returned by view (for Hub, supply id); delete confirms the full current body. Session defaults to agent; user authority and changes to user items require exact-content human approval. Child sessions accept no explicit authority, including agent. Hub is shared by ALL projects of this Hub; a write needs the user to approve it in a dialog (terminal or web). scope=global inside memory text is NOT cross-project. No human proof/remote channel means refusal, not queueing or resending. Never store secrets.

id.description: Exact target id. Required for update/delete; Hub view with id returns actual rev.

text.description: Full body for create/update. Delete always freezes the actual current body, never supplied substitute text.

rev.description: Actual current revision from view, required for update/delete CAS.

topic.description: Hub create topic (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). Not accepted for session.

from.description: Optional provenance link session:nN or project:<reference>; does not grant authority or move the source.
